snippets.body: Our Mission is to discover, build and celebrate the ability in all people.
snippets.attribution: Ability Beyond · About Ability Beyond — https://www.abilitybeyond.org/about-us

snippets.body: Throughout our residential programs, we are implementing the latest technology to enhance care and increase autonomy, empowering individuals to live fulfilling, independent lives.
In 2005 we became one of the first to close sheltered workshops and transition people with disabilities into community-based employment.
snippets.attribution: Ability Beyond · About Ability Beyond — https://www.abilitybeyond.org/about-us

snippets.body: Innovative tech solutions are improving quality and driving efficiency, and we are planning for the future with our Making Beyond Possible campaign to raise $20M.
snippets.attribution: Ability Beyond · About Ability Beyond — https://www.abilitybeyond.org/about-us

snippets.body: We work with thousands of people in Connecticut and New York, who are living with developmental disabilities, autism spectrum disorder, brain injury, mental illness, and often, accompanying physical challenges.
snippets.attribution: Ability Beyond · About Ability Beyond — https://www.abilitybeyond.org/about-us

snippets.body: Founded more than 70 years ago, Ability Beyond has grown to provide services to more than 3,000 people with disabilities across Connecticut and New York.
snippets.attribution: Ability Beyond · About Ability Beyond — https://www.abilitybeyond.org/about-us

snippets.body: Recognizing an unmet need for support for children like their son Jim, Mary and Jack Walsh gathered other parents in their living room in 1953 and a mission was born.
snippets.attribution: Ability Beyond · About Ability Beyond — https://www.abilitybeyond.org/about-us

snippets.body: Ability Beyond will soon help hundreds of job seekers in recovery from substance use find and maintain employment across Connecticut, thanks to competitive grants from the Department of Mental Health and Addiction Services (DMHAS).
Grow your career with us and join over 1,200 employees who work every day to make dreams come true.
snippets.attribution: Ability Beyond · Careers at Ability Beyond — https://www.abilitybeyond.org/careers

snippets.body: Through this program, Ability Beyond direct care employees have the opportunity to train to become Direct Support Professionals, and to then earn advanced certifications in specialty areas including aging, behavioral supports, medical supports, mental health, and mentoring and supervision.
snippets.attribution: Ability Beyond · Careers at Ability Beyond — https://www.abilitybeyond.org/careers

snippets.body: The people from Ability Beyond know how to listen.
snippets.attribution: Ability Beyond · Residential Living (Lorraine Lazurus-Morley, Mother of Bryce) — https://www.abilitybeyond.org/residential

snippets.body: Based on each individual's level of need, our residential programs in Connecticut and New York provide up to 24 hours of support each day.
We are a 24/7 organization that offers a wide variety of work schedules.
snippets.attribution: Ability Beyond · Careers at Ability Beyond — https://www.abilitybeyond.org/careers
